words.word: yea also when he that is a fool

occurrences.text: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.
Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?
Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth him, and he saith to every one that he is a fool.
words: Yea also when he that is a fool

occurrences.text: A fool also is full of words: a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him?
For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.
Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:
